scope: Complete six-model panel over all 4,795 MORQ questions, including the public-redraw textbook task.
textbook_stimulus_note: All 1,182 released textbook observations were measured on the distributed public redraws.
system_prompt:
You are an expert organic chemist. Your task is to answer organic chemistry questions from the provided text, images, reaction schemes, molecular structures, and labels. Always provide your thinking process.
First, provide a concise chemical rationale in ordinary text. Focus on the key functional group transformations, reaction conditions, selectivity, stereochemistry, structural features, and mechanistic plausibility when they are relevant to the question.
Then provide exactly one XML-style answer block in the following format: <ANS>...</ANS>.
The content inside the <ANS> tags must contain ONLY the final answer required by the question. Do NOT put any extra text inside the <ANS> tags. Do NOT write anything after the closing </ANS> tag.

request_construction.messages: system prompt followed by the question row's user_prompt
request_construction.image_input: for non-empty image_path, Base64-encode the released asset and submit it as image_url with MIME type inferred from its extension; otherwise submit text only

terminal_failure_policy.rule: Retain every requested model-question observation in the denominator; every terminal failure receives zero score and fails response-format compliance.

claude-opus-4-8.note: No sampling field is declared in the public protocol; endpoint defaults applied.

claude-sonnet-5.note: No sampling field was set in the replacement-panel runner; endpoint defaults applied.

gpt-4o.note: No sampling field is declared in the public protocol; endpoint defaults applied.

gpt-5.2.note: No sampling field is declared in the public protocol; endpoint defaults applied.

replacement_panel_execution.retry_boundary: Transient HTTP 408, 409, 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504 responses and transient network failures were eligible for bounded retries with exponential backoff. Permanent authentication, authorization, routing, model-identity and balance/quota failures stopped the applicable run.

argon_targeted_recovery.note: The two unresolved Argon observations received targeted streamed recovery. One exhausted a 16,384-token ceiling without an <ANS> block and one repeatedly returned provider timeout; both were terminalized under the stated failure policy.

provenance_boundary: This file documents the shared request format and the verified replacement-panel execution settings. It does not reconstruct provider-side defaults, provider-internal model revisions, raw completions, or every intermediate retry used for the earlier retained Claude Opus, GPT-4o and GPT-5.2 baselines.
